d: Jungle ho, registan ho ya khatarnak daldal, wilderness mein survive karne ke liye sabse pehle zaroori hai food aur water dhoondhna! Adventurer Bear Grylls nikal pada hai apne next survival challenge par. Kabhi Baja Desert mein honey ki talaash, kabhi Louisiana ke swamps mein catfish pakadne ka challenge, toh kabhi Oregon ke freezing waters aur Dominican Republic ke challenging terrain mein survival ki jung! Is compilation mein Bear ke kuchh behtareen survival techniques bhi dekhne ko milenge. Har jagah ek naya challenge, aur har meal ke liye jaan laga dene wali mehnat! Dekhiye kaise Bear…
